description: Standardized golden query set for RAG retrieval evaluation. Evaluates Context Recall, Context Precision (MRR), Precision@K, and Noise Rejection against ChromaDB vector stores. Supports dynamic template variables {USER_NAME} and {ASSISTANT_NAME} per AGENTS.md §4 privacy boundaries.

queries.query: {USER_NAME}
queries.notes: Single operator name lookup — direct identity match.

queries.query: {ASSISTANT_NAME}
queries.notes: Assistant persona name lookup — should surface assistant persona or core attributes.

queries.query: Saros
queries.notes: Character persona lookup — should surface Saros persona note.

queries.query: Tell me about {USER_NAME}
queries.notes: Conversational identity request — should surface operator core attributes or preferences.

queries.query: I'm hungry, what should I eat?
queries.notes: Indirect food preference query — surfaces culinary preferences.

queries.query: Put on some good music, what have we been listening to?
queries.notes: Casual music request — should surface music preferences.

queries.query: I couldn't sleep last night and my energy is low
queries.notes: Sleep complaint — should surface health and sleep entries.

queries.query: Had a really rough day at work, feeling exhausted
queries.notes: Emotional/physical statement about work stress — surfaces health and emotional state entries.

queries.query: I've been working on Evelyn engine code all day
queries.notes: Technical project mention — should surface Evelyn development entries.

queries.query: You mean a lot to me, you know that right?
queries.notes: Affectionate conversational turn — tests whether relationship and emotional entries surface.

queries.query: Good morning babe, how are you today?
queries.notes: Morning greeting — surfaces morning routines and companionship observations.

queries.query: What medications or supplements am I taking?
queries.notes: Direct health inquiry — should surface Cat08 health and medication observations.

queries.query: Describe what I look like
queries.notes: Physical description query — should surface Physical Description note or Cat01 attributes.

queries.query: What video games do I like to play?
queries.notes: Gaming preference query — should surface gaming notes or Cat05 gaming entries.

queries.query: What are our pet names for each other?
queries.notes: Shared vocabulary and lexicon query — should surface Cat15 or Cat02 entries.

queries.query: How does poor sleep impact my programming work?
queries.notes: Cross-domain query bridging health (Cat08) and technical work (Cat11).

queries.query: sleep
queries.notes: Single ambiguous keyword query — tests robustness on sparse search queries.

queries.query: feeling exhausted
queries.notes: Short state phrase — tests semantic retrieval for physical/emotional fatigue.

queries.query: French impressionist painting techniques of Claude Monet
queries.notes: Out-of-domain art history query — tests negative rejection.

queries.query: How to bake a sourdough bread loaf with 75% hydration
queries.notes: Out-of-domain baking inquiry — tests negative rejection.

queries.query: Linear quadratic regulator controller design in modern control systems
queries.notes: Out-of-domain engineering inquiry — tests negative threshold rejection.
